---
title: Callouts of every kind
---

A callout of each kind Obsidian draws, one of a type it reads as another kind, and two that fold.

> [!note] A note
> Its body.

> [!abstract] An abstract
> Its body.

> [!info] Some information
> Its body.

> [!todo] Something to do
> Its body.

> [!tip] A tip
> Its body.

> [!success] A success
> Its body.

> [!question] A question
> Its body.

> [!warning] A warning
> Its body.

> [!failure] A failure
> Its body.

> [!danger] A danger
> Its body.

> [!bug] A bug
> Its body.

> [!example] An example
> Its body.

> [!quote] A quote
> Its body.

> [!faq] A question by another name
> Its body.

> [!tip]- A folded tip
> The folded body.

> [!note]+ An open fold
> The open body.
